text:
Which statement about the elements in Group VIII is correct?
A
They all form diatomic molecules.
B
They all have eight electrons in their outer electron shells.
C
They all react with oxygen to form oxides.
D
They all are gases at room temperature.

options.label: B
options.text: They all have eight electrons in their outer electron shells.

options.label: C
options.text: They all react with oxygen to form oxides.

options.label: D
options.text: They all are gases at room temperature.
